_README.purpose: Canonical pointers and displays for load-bearing historical magnitudes.
_README.update_rule: After a result changes, run scripts/check_results_ledger.py and reconcile every reported mismatch.

robustness_vocab.structural: true by construction / model- and dataset-independent (e.g. a paper-shaped projection CANNOT exceed chance on within-recipe ranking). Does not decay on re-run.
robustness_vocab.sample-dependent: the effect exists but its magnitude is specific to this (often selection-biased, success-biased) public dataset; do not quote as representative of real lab data.
robustness_vocab.descriptive-noninferential: reported as a point statistic at n too small for inference (e.g. n=6 sources); directional only.
robustness_vocab.inference-not-measured: a claim asserted but whose stated form is not yet backed by a measured run in a manifest.

source_kinds.manifest: value lives in a run manifest; 'pointer' is the dotted JSON path. The checker resolves it -- the ledger 'display' must round-match the live value or the check fails.
source_kinds.by_construction: value is structural (e.g. 0.500 forced tie); no manifest field owns it. 'note' states why it is fixed.
source_kinds.literal: value has no single manifest field (composite/derived across runs); stored here with explicit 'provenance'. This is the one denormalized case; keep it rare.

severson_ab_rank_ridge.metric: Severson A-full (grammar: recipe + trajectory) within-recipe replicate-ranking pairwise accuracy, ridge, held-out-policy; ranking-robustness run (k=100, 160 pairs, 3 seeds).
severson_ab_rank_ridge.claim_served: claim 3 / event-grammar A-B: a grammar-preserved record ranks replicates of one recipe; the ranking signal is real on Severson WITHIN-CORPUS. Requalified 2026-07-08: does not transfer across collection batches (see severson_heldout_batch_rank_ridge) — quote the two keys together.

severson_ab_rank_models_clearing.metric: Number of model families (of 5: ridge, knn, svr_rbf, forest, gradient_boosting) whose within-recipe replicate-ranking clears the pre-registered bar. Tree ensembles (forest 0.596, gbt 0.534) are the outlier class.
severson_ab_rank_models_clearing.claim_served: ranking signal is model-general; tree ensembles are the exception, not a signal limit.

severson_ab_rank_forest.metric: Severson A-full within-recipe replicate-ranking pairwise accuracy, random forest (the tree-ensemble outlier that fails to clear the bar).
severson_ab_rank_forest.claim_served: tree ensembles are the outlier model class on the ranking sub-task.

severson_ab_rank_paper_baseline.metric: Paper-shaped baseline B (recipe + final label) within-recipe replicate ranking. Forced to a chance tie because the projection is identical for replicates of one recipe -- it cannot rank them at all.
severson_ab_rank_paper_baseline.claim_served: claim 3: paper-shaping structurally destroys replicate-ranking information; this bound is model- and dataset-independent.

source.note: B's feature vector is constant across replicates of a recipe, so any ranker ties at 0.500 by construction; verified bitwise in severson_representation_ab.json.

severson_ab_primary_rank_ridge.metric: Legacy Severson primary A/B table: A-full within-policy replicate ranking under ridge. The surviving live manifest was later regenerated on a different/full event set and does not contain this exact cell; do not use this magnitude as a headline.
severson_ab_primary_rank_ridge.claim_served: historical result-table value retained for auditability; superseded for current claims by manifest-backed ranking robustness and held-batch results.

source.provenance: docs/controlled-collection/severson_representation_ab.md within-policy ranking table (A-full ridge); no surviving manifest pointer reproduces this exact historical cell.

severson_batch_recoverability.metric: Provenance-leakage audit on Severson A/B: worst-case batch (collection date) recoverability from the trajectory feature set. Severe.
severson_batch_recoverability.claim_served: provenance protocol: collection provenance is recoverable on a non-spectral modality (battery cycling); replicates opXRD.
severson_batch_recoverability._note: SKILL.md states this result qualitatively (no magnitude), so it is intentionally NOT in cited_in.

opxrd_provenance_worst.metric: Provenance-recoverability audit on opXRD: worst-case archive-source-label recoverability from standardized deposited patterns, metadata, and curation features; laboratory is not separately identified.
opxrd_provenance_worst.claim_served: calibration: bundled archive-source labels are recoverable from public standardized XRD records.

recoverability_vs_transfer_spectral.metric: opXRD recoverability-vs-downstream-transfer: Spearman of per-source SPECTRAL recoverability vs held-out-source transfer badness. ~0 -- recoverability does NOT predict transfer difficulty.
recoverability_vs_transfer_spectral.claim_served: recoverability is a screening/risk signal, NOT a downstream-transfer predictor (n=6).
recoverability_vs_transfer_spectral._note: SKILL.md states the 'risk signal not transfer predictor' claim qualitatively (no magnitude); tracked via claim_served, not cited_in. Primary docs may write the correlation as ~0 / +0.03 in prose -- an advisory, not a hard mismatch.

recoverability_vs_transfer_size.metric: opXRD recoverability-vs-transfer: descriptive Spearman of per-source log(n_samples) vs transfer badness in a six-source table.
recoverability_vs_transfer_size.claim_served: source size had the larger descriptive association at n=6; this sharpens the 'risk signal, not predictor' framing without establishing a size effect.

rruff_garnet_raman_species.metric: RRUFF deposited processed Raman: cross-specimen 5-way garnet species classification accuracy. The 2-way family label is easier to recover; this is a label-granularity result, not proof of a continuous or true latent coordinate.
rruff_garnet_raman_species.claim_served: calibration: selected spectra retain distinctions represented differently by coarse family and fine species labels.

rruff_garnet_raman_within_family_error.metric: RRUFF deposited processed Raman: fraction of species-classification errors that stay within the labeled structural family.
rruff_garnet_raman_within_family_error.claim_served: calibration: fine-label errors are structured by the coarser family taxonomy.

rruff_garnet_xrd_species.metric: RRUFF deposited processed powder XRD: 5-way garnet species accuracy; the coarser 2-way family label is easier to recover.
rruff_garnet_xrd_species.claim_served: calibration: the coarse-versus-fine label-recoverability pattern appears in a second deposited processed modality.

severson_heldout_batch_rank_ridge.metric: Severson A-full within-recipe replicate-ranking pairwise accuracy, ridge, HELD-OUT-BATCH scoring (train on 2 batches, rank pairs in the third), on batch 3 (2018-04-12, the only adequately-powered cell: 136 of 160 pairs). Collapses to chance from the 0.779 leave-one-policy-out accuracy on the same pairs -- the ranking rule does not transfer across collection batches.
severson_heldout_batch_rank_ridge.claim_served: claim 3 provenance-stress: the 0.756 within-recipe ranking magnitude is within-corpus/batch-calibrated, NOT transferable cell physics; the structural A>B separation is untouched.

severson_early_lifetime_spearman.metric: Severson Run 015: leave-one-out early-trajectory -> cycle-life Spearman. Early trajectory predicts lifetime, but the lossy signal is confounded by charging policy (extrinsic).
severson_early_lifetime_spearman.claim_served: early-trajectory predicts lifetime, but extrinsic process labels need controlled conditions -- reinforces controlled-collection.
